introSection.title: The newest residential retreat on Galveston Beach
introSection.intro: Exceptional amenities with green-space terraces that harmoniously blend ecological mindfulness and breathtaking architecture.

introImages.alt1: A residence living room with Gulf views

pillars.title: Glass, concrete, wood and sea
pillars.body: A modern, sophisticated condominium embedded into the seaside beachfront environment — a fusion of minimalist design and breathtaking architectural style.

pillars.title: Secure and technologically advanced
pillars.body: Reserved parking with EV charging, secure facilities with private beach access, and 24/7 security monitoring.

pillars.title: Built to live mindfully
pillars.body: A members spa with sauna and cold plunge, adults-only and family pools, a wine vault and a curated library — amenities designed for expression, substance and growth.

features.title: Amenities to live mindfully
features.body: A members spa with sauna, cold plunge and hot yoga. Adults-only and family pools overlooking the beach, a sunset rooftop lounge, private rooftop terraces, and a wine vault with a sommelier table.

features.title: Five penthouses above it all
features.body: Three-bedroom penthouses up to 3,000 square feet, with private terraces and the penthouse-level pool looking straight out over the Gulf.
features.imageAlt: The penthouse pool with the Gulf beyond

features.title: Directly on Galveston Beach
features.body: A private dune walkover protects the dunes and simplifies the journey to the sand. Pool-level restrooms with showers and lockers, a beach-inspired fire pit, and one of the most tranquil stretches of the island's west end.
features.imageAlt: Galveston beach dunes with the Gulf behind

amenitiesSection.title: Amenities to live mindfully
amenitiesSection.intro: Built to push your body, relax your mind, and make you present in the moments that truly matter.

amenities: Secure facilities with private beach access

locationSection.title: Feel yourself let go of the noise of life
locationSection.intro: Directly on Galveston Beach at the quiet west end of the island — the peaceful sea breeze, the waves that never seem to end, and the gentle flowing dunes.

locationImageAlt: Galveston beach dunes and the Gulf
